recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further work should only occur if PA makes a new decision to add a separate status-history or status-effective element beyond the notAvailableTime closure mechanism approved for R5.
issue_request: FHIR-26641 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. The original request asked for status change date/period support on Location, and the approved resolution narrowed this to copying the notAvailable structure from HealthcareService and PractitionerRole into Location, with availabilityExceptions as a textual option for closures.
initial_application: Commit 447e89f4a40f92d16f33490766f29b9bce017236 explicitly cited FHIR-26641 and changed Location.hoursOfOperation to the shared Availability datatype, which provides notAvailableTime.description and notAvailableTime.during. Commit 896a7fadf5d0db4d8aed896a6edc1cf569f20932 also cited FHIR-26641 but only corrected the newly added Location.virtualService path. Commit 7b3274152e23b9f3697c9d303be1be832dd811fa later added Location-specific notes for hoursOfOperation.notAvailableTime.
additional_context: FHIR-25381 is the same implementation family because it created the shared Availability datatype used by Location, HealthcareService, and PractitionerRole. source/fhir.ini lists Location as active and records the R5 mapping from Location.availabilityExceptions to Location.hoursOfOperation.notAvailableTime.description after the datatype refactor. Later combined-branch availability reconciliations for FHIR-41311 and FHIR-32500 refine adjacent Availability wording but do not remove or weaken notAvailableTime closure support.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because Location.hoursOfOperation is type Availability, Availability.notAvailableTime includes both description and during Period, and the Location notes tell implementers to use hoursOfOperation.notAvailableTime for public holidays or planned maintenance and preferably include actual start/end dates.

related_jiras.note: Created the shared Availability datatype and replaced the Location, HealthcareService, and PractitionerRole availability structures in the same implementation commit.
